# Broadmoor Outfitters

> > Guided outdoor adventures and corporate experiences in Colorado Springs, featuring hiking, biking, and zip-lining tours near Pikes Peak and The Broadmoor Resort.

Broadmoor Outfitters specializes in outdoor recreation and team-building activities in the Colorado Springs area, offering everything from family-friendly hikes near Garden of the Gods to corporate adventures and the Broadmoor Soaring Adventure zip-line tours at Seven Falls. The company partners with The Broadmoor luxury resort to provide guided experiences on mountain trails, bike tours, and the unique Pikes Peak Cog Up-Bike Down adventure.

## Key Topics

- Colorado Springs outdoor activities
- Pikes Peak adventures
- Garden of the Gods hiking
- Seven Falls zip-lining
- Broadmoor Soaring Adventure

- Family-friendly trails

- Adventure tourism Colorado

- [Pikes Peak Cog Up - Bike Down Adventure Trip](https://www.broadmooroutfitters.com/socialacitivities/cogup): Pikes Peak Cog Railway up, downhill bike tour adventure in CO Springs
